snippet.title: The Pale City, PC Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Pale City is a story-driven, dark fantasy RPG for PC with an emphasis on characterization and atmosphere. Explore a dangerous, morally complex world where every detail is personal.

Available March 20th, 2020, on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1196580/The_Pale_City/

Or, for more information, please check the official website:
https://thepalecity.com/

Trailer by Jennifer Wu.
